parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the safe is a thick steel panel that covers the front opening of the safe.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main barrier protecting the contents inside the safe, designed to resist forced entry and fire.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close, typically swinging outward.

parts.name: Lock (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The lock mechanism is a steel component integrated into the door, used to secure it in place.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents unauthorized access by engaging locking bolts when the safe is closed and locked.
parts.Movement_description: It operates through rotational or combination input, engaging or disengaging internal bolts.

parts.name: Handle (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The handle is a steel lever attached to the door, used to operate the locking mechanism and open the door.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to manually engage or disengage the locking bolts and pull the door open.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or turns to actuate the lock and can be pulled to open the door.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main steel enclosure forming the structure of the safe.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the structural integrity and protection for the contents, supporting the door and lock assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
